_about: Every cookie and browser-storage key the Bookplus BUSINESS app (business.bookplus.pro) uses, classified for the cookie banner and the Privacy Policy. 'necessary' items are always on; 'analytics' items exist only after 'Accept analytics'. Keep in step with apps/customer/src/legal/cookies.json and the code (packages/api-client/src/consent.ts).

categories.necessary: Needed to sign you in, keep the service secure, and remember choices you made. Always on; nothing here tracks you.
categories.analytics: Bookplus's own page-visit and booking-funnel counts. Off until you tap 'Accept analytics'. No advertising, no third parties.

items.purpose: Your sign-in (short-lived access token) so pages you open stay signed in.
items.duration: Until you log out; the token inside expires after 15 minutes and is renewed automatically

items.purpose: Renews your sign-in without asking for your password again.
items.duration: Until you log out, or it expires (30 days)

items.purpose: A copy of your basic profile (name, role) so the app can draw its screens before the server answers.
Legacy key from an older version; deleted when you log out. No longer written.
Remembers the light/dark theme you picked.
Remembers that you dismissed the 'turn on notifications' prompt.
Remembers your cookie choice ('Only necessary' or 'Accept analytics') and when you made it.
items.duration: Until you change it or clear site data

items.purpose: A random ID that links page visits and booking steps from this device, so we can see where people drop off. Only created after you tap 'Accept analytics'; deleted when you choose 'Only necessary'.
items.duration: Until you withdraw consent or clear site data
items.sentTo: Bookplus API (POST /api/events) — our own analytics, no third parties

items.purpose: Keeps you signed in across app.bookplus.pro and business.bookplus.pro (single sign-on refresh token). Not readable by page scripts.
items.duration: 30 days, renewed while you use the app; removed at log-out

items.purpose: Security check for 'Continue with Google' — proves the sign-in was started from this browser.
Shows the full welcome splash only on the very first open.
Stops the one-time 'how was signing up?' question from showing again.
Remembers that you dismissed the 'finish setting up' reminder.

thirdPartyOnRequest.when: Only after you tap 'Show map' when setting your business location
thirdPartyOnRequest.note: Google receives your IP address and may set its own cookies.

thirdPartyOnRequest.when: When you drop a map pin or tap 'Use current location'
thirdPartyOnRequest.note: The coordinates are sent to look up the street address. No cookies.

thirdPartyOnRequest.when: Only when you tap 'Continue with Google'
thirdPartyOnRequest.note: You leave Bookplus for Google's sign-in page.

thirdPartyOnRequest.when: Photos are shown; files you upload
thirdPartyOnRequest.note: Image hosting. Proofs of payment are stored privately.
